name: otter-documentation
description: Official documentation site infrastructure for Otter.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-examples.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check-site.mjs
scripts.build:library: node scripts/build-library-catalog.mjs && node scripts/build-library-thumbnails.mjs && node scripts/build-library-pages.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:library && npm run test:e2e && npm run validate:components && npm run audit:otter
scripts.dev:otter: npm run build:otter && npm run audit:otter && npm run serve:otter
